title: Morph From Ghost Participants
description: When many participants morph into one, use morphFrom ghost slots per source participant instead of union group tiles. Framework expand + deck refactor.
summary:
Many-to-one morphs use per-source ghost dispositions instead of union group tiles.

- Core: `MorphFromSlot`, `Disposition.morphFrom`, `expandArrangementMorphFrom`, `splitTilesBoundingFrame`, `splitTilesUnionSourceCrop`, `DispositionSplit.morphParticipant`, `morphTargetId` for line targets.
- Bridge expansion uses participant morph ids; final slide uses `targetLineIndex` for text line pairing.
- Renderer: `morphParticipant` split renders dormant participant anchor + visible tiles; heading-block positioned labels.
- Deck: column splits on Bauteilarten; single `catalogue-labels` participant with three `morphFrom` ghosts on Bauteilbeschriftungen.
